verdict.rationale: Databricks publishes a pricing page describing a pay-as-you-go model with no up-front costs and per-second billing granularity. That establishes a documented pricing model, but nothing in the pack shows unit rates, SKU or tier breakdowns, or a cost calculator that would let a platform engineer turn a workload into a monthly estimate before committing. Budgets track spend after the fact, which is adjacent to this story and earns no credit here. Missing for 10: published per-unit rates by product or tier, a pre-purchase pricing calculator or estimation guide, worked cost examples, and independent confirmation that estimates match actual bills.
